chosen.retriever_detail: RRF k=60 over dense (EmbeddingGemma 2 768d, pgvector Day 6 strategy B, exact cosine) and BM25 (k1=1.5, b=0.75), pool 20 each
chosen.context: cumulative, dedup by id, retrieval order, skip chunk if over budget

reason: Criteria 1-3 (results/selection_criteria.md): hybrid ties bm25 and beats all dense and other configs (C1-C4). Criterion 4: bm25 uses ~2% fewer input tokens but is 0.09 s slower per question, treated as a tie; tie broken by retrieval diagnostics (Evidence Hit@3 17/17 vs 16/17, MRR 0.863 vs 0.860) and by keeping the Day 6 vector store in the chosen pipeline. Prompt v2 (+17% tokens, no gain) and smaller context (quality loss) rejected.
